extraction.notes: The provider has posted two scheduled 2027 teen trips, both outside North Carolina. Other destinations are now advertised as custom group trips rather than scheduled individual summer offerings; older teen offerings in the FAQ were not carried forward. Registration is promoted now, but no dated 2027 opening was found. The registration page mixes a 2027 heading with 2026 payment and cancellation dates; its October 1 early-bird deadline has no year, so it was not recorded as a 2027 milestone.

cards.name: Hawaii Teen Adventure - Kauai
cards.description: Teens learn to surf, hike, swim and snorkel on Kauai, and sail along the Napali Coast. The trip includes community service, devotional time and Christian small-group activities.

financial_aid.text: Scholarship funds may be available through generous supporters of Created for Adventure.

lunch.text: Most food, overland travel, lodging, all activities, and group gear. Not included: airfare, personal gear, and a couple of meals out (including travel day meals).

transportation.text: Our Trip Leaders will meet all campers at the airport and will constantly check for any changes in travel plans.
